articles.description: Police and revenue officials had received information from local residents over a month ago that a mosque was being constructed illegally on land meant for public use in Qutubpur Satta village

articles.headline: US House begins vote on motion to advance Pete Hegseth impeachment
articles.title: US House Republicans block Pete Hegseth impeachment effort
articles.summary: The United States House of Representatives commenced a procedural vote on Tuesday to evaluate an impeachment resolution against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Introduced by Republican Representative Thomas Massie, the measure accuses the Pentagon chief of launching an illegal war against Iran and overseeing extrajudicial strikes. Democrats support the initiative, while President Donald Trump and party leaders maintain their backing.
articles.description: Hegseth has been accused of spearheading war on Iran without required congressional approval.

articles.headline: Punjab Police file case over death threat against Arvind Kejriwal
articles.title: Kejriwal, his daughter get death threat from ‘Bishnoi gang member’; case filed in Punjab
articles.summary: The Punjab Police registered a case after Delhi Aam Aadmi Party MLA Jarnail Singh reported receiving a death threat and a seven crore rupee extortion demand. According to the complaint filed at the Cyber Crime Police Station in Mohali, an individual claiming to be part of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang targeted Arvind Kejriwal and his daughter Harshita Kejriwal.
articles.description: Delhi AAP MLA Jarnail Singh alleged caller demanded ₹7 crore from Mr. Kejriwal and threatened to kill him and his daughter Harshita Kejriwal if the money was not paid

articles.headline: Manchester United sack manager Michael Carrick amid relegation struggles
articles.title: Manchester United sack Michael Carrick as manager
articles.summary: Manchester United confirmed the departure of men's first-team head coach Michael Carrick on November 12, 2026, following their worst start to an English top-flight season in 40 years. Sitting in the Premier League relegation zone, the club announced they will appoint a permanent successor swiftly, with Mauricio Pochettino heavily linked to the vacant managerial position.
articles.description: This is a breaking news story.

articles.headline: Manchester United dismisses manager Michael Carrick following poor season start
articles.title: Manchester United sack Michael Carrick as manager
articles.summary: Manchester United has sacked head coach Michael Carrick after the club fell into the Premier League relegation zone. The team has struggled significantly this season, recording only three wins in 15 matches across all competitions. The club is now seeking a permanent successor, with US national team coach Mauricio Pochettino reportedly emerging as the leading candidate.
articles.description: Carrick exits after United drop to 18th in Premier League table; he led them to three wins across all competitions.

articles.headline: Owaisi and Azad likely to announce Uttar Pradesh election alliance
articles.title: Owaisi names Chandrashekhar Azad as Uttar Pradesh CM face of Samajik Parivartan Morcha
articles.summary: All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen president Asaduddin Owaisi and Azad Samaj Party chief Chandrashekhar Azad are expected to declare a political alliance for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh state assembly elections during a joint press conference in Lucknow. The potential coalition aims to consolidate Scheduled Caste and minority voters in the state, presenting a new electoral front outside the major political blocs according to analysts.
articles.description: In a joint press conference with the AIMIM chief, Mr. Azad said, “If SP, Congress or any other party wants to join us to stop BJP from coming to power, we are open to it”

articles.headline: Seoyon and Hwashin commit ₹1,370 crore in investments to Tamil Nadu
articles.title: Amid reports of Korean firms shifting to Andhra Pradesh, Hwashin and Seoyon commit ₹1,370-crore investments in Tamil Nadu
articles.summary: South Korean automotive component makers Seoyon E-Hwa Summit Automotive India Private Limited and Hwashin Automotive India Private Limited committed investments totalling ₹1,370 crore in Tamil Nadu on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Hwashin pledged ₹850 crore for research and advanced manufacturing over five years, while Seoyon committed ₹520 crore for technology upgrades. The announcement follows reports that both firms were considering shifting investments to Andhra Pradesh.
articles.description: A formal MoU is expected to be signed at the upcoming Investment Conversion Conclave of the TVK government

articles.headline: Noel Tata retires as Tata Investment Corporation chairperson with successor named
articles.title: Noel Tata retires as Tata Investment chaiperson; Bahram Vakil to succeed him
articles.summary: Noel Tata stepped down as chairperson and director of Tata Investment Corporation on November 11, 2026, concluding over sixteen years of leadership. In accordance with Tata Group Governance Guidelines, the board appointed Bahram Vakil as the new chairperson effective November 12, 2026, while also naming Abizer Shabbir Diwanji as an independent director.
articles.description: Recognising his contribution, the board appointed Mr. Tata ‘Chairman Emeritus’ with effect from November 12

articles.headline: United Nations peacekeeping patrol comes under fire in southern Lebanon
articles.title: UNIFIL patrol comes under fire in southern Lebanon
articles.summary: A United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon patrol faced about a dozen rounds of gunfire near Wadi Jilu in the Tyre district on Tuesday, according to the peacekeeping mission. The unit returned fire and reported no casualties before calling for an investigation. The incident highlights ongoing security concerns as G7 foreign ministers debate the future of the force ahead of its mandate expiration in December 2026.
articles.description: UNIFIL said on Tuesday that 'about a dozen rounds' were fired at one of its patrols, without identifying the assailants.

articles.headline: Infosys Science Foundation announces six winners of Infosys Prize 2026
articles.title: Six researchers win Infosys Science Foundation prizes for 2026
articles.summary: The Infosys Science Foundation announced the recipients of the Infosys Prize 2026 across six academic categories on November 12, 2026. Each laureate receives a gold medal, citation, and a prize purse of $100,000. Among the winners is Riddhipratim Basu from the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, selected by an international panel of jurors evaluating early career researchers under forty.
articles.description: A total of 222 applications were received across six categories with the highest for ‘Engineering and Computer Science’ category, ISF said

articles.headline: OpenAI introduces local API processing and model inference for Indian enterprises
articles.title: OpenAI now allows enterprises to process AI requests within India
articles.summary: OpenAI announced local processing and inference for its application programming interface in India on November 12, 2026, enabling eligible businesses to execute workloads entirely within the country. The update extends existing data residency offerings to cover model computations and responses for the GPT-6 Luna model, addressing data localisation requirements for sectors like financial services.
articles.description: The facility initially supports GPT-6 Luna through OpenAI’s API, allowing requests to be processed and AI responses generated within the country to address enterprise data localisation requirements

articles.headline: Madras High Court sentences senior IAS officer Anshul Mishra to imprisonment
articles.title: Madras High Court sentences senior IAS officer to one-month simple imprisonment in contempt case
articles.summary: The Madras High Court found Indian Administrative Service officer Anshul Mishra guilty of contempt of court, ordering him to undergo simple imprisonment for one month. Justice P. Velmurugan directed the court registry to secure the custody of the former Chennai Metropolitan Development Authority Member Secretary if he fails to appeal within thirty days.
articles.description: Justice P. Velmurugan also directs Anshul Mishra, former member secretary of CMDA, to pay a compensation of ₹25,000 from his salary to two aged petitioners

articles.headline: Delhi’s air was already toxic before Deepavali. Here’s what a new study found

articles.description: A new analysis by the Centre for Science and Environment (CSE) has found that Delhi entered the Deepavali season with its worst pre-festival air quality in three years.

articles.headline: BBC Verify finds discrepancies in Delhi air pollution data during Diwali
articles.title: Was Delhi pollution data during Diwali misleading?
articles.summary: BBC Verify revealed that official datasets from the Central Pollution Control Board omitted hourly particulate matter readings exceeding 1,000 micrograms during Diwali celebrations in Delhi. Researchers warned that excluding extreme pollution episodes from monitoring stations misrepresents actual air quality levels and prevents accurate daily averages, potentially undermining public trust in official figures across the capital city.
articles.description: BBC Verify analysis indicates missing data led official Diwali pollution figures to be lower than they should be.

articles.headline: Infosys Science Foundation announces six winners for the 2026 Infosys Prize
articles.title: Bengaluru researcher among six Infosys Science Foundation prize winners for 2026
articles.summary: The Infosys Science Foundation announced six laureates for the Infosys Prize 2026 on November 12, honoring researchers under forty across multiple academic disciplines. Each category winner receives a gold medal, citation, and one hundred thousand dollars. Recipients include Riddhipratim Basu from ICTS-TIFR in Bengaluru, alongside scholars from Princeton, Carnegie Mellon, Jindal Global Law School, Gladstone Institutes, and Singapore University of Technology and Design.
articles.description: A total of 222 applications were received across six categories with the highest for ‘Engineering and Computer Science’ category, ISF said

articles.headline: US military member arrested in the UK on suspicion of espionage
articles.title: US soldier arrested in UK on suspicion of spying for Russia
articles.summary: British authorities detained an unidentified 41-year-old United States military member near Gloucester on Tuesday under the National Security Act 2023 for allegedly assisting a foreign intelligence service. London Metropolitan Police counterterrorism forces collaborated with the FBI and US military on the operation. The suspect remains in custody in London while officers search two Gloucestershire properties.
articles.description: London Metropolitan Police says its 'counterterror' forces worked closely with the FBI and US military to make arrest.

articles.headline: Congressional report finds federal failures in Jeffrey Epstein investigation
articles.title: US federal authorities could have prevented Epstein crimes, report finds
articles.summary: Crimes committed by late financier Jeffrey Epstein after 2005 could have been prevented due to investigative and prosecutorial failures, a congressional investigation concluded on Tuesday. The Republican-led House Oversight Committee released its final report following a fifteen-month review, criticizing the united states attorney office for a 2007 agreement allowing Epstein to evade federal prosecution. The panel also cited institutional failures at the New York prison where Epstein died in 2019.
articles.description: The report by a Republican-led congressional committee follows a 15-month investigation into the handling of the late disgraced financier's case.

articles.headline: Salvadoran troops target Haitian gang in operation leaving 20 dead
articles.title: Salvadoran troops target Haitian gang, leaving 20 dead
articles.summary: Salvadoran forces supported an operation by Haitian police on Sunday that targeted the 400 Mawozo gang headquarters in Croix-des-Bouquets, resulting in twenty deaths. Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced the attack on social media platform X. Amnesty International subsequently urged both governments to ensure that all military deployments comply strictly with international human rights law.
articles.description: Salvadoran troops backed the police operation ahead of the Haitian prime minister’s visit to El Salvador.

articles.headline: British police arrest US Army soldier near Gloucester for alleged Russian espionage
articles.title: US Army soldier suspected of spying for Russia arrested in UK
articles.summary: Counter Terrorism Policing London detained a forty-one-year-old senior serviceman near Gloucester under the National Security Act 2023 on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence. articles.description: The 41-year-old senior soldier is accused of national security offences and is being questioned in London.

articles.headline: Vizianagaram district expects increased investments from Bhogapuram airport development

articles.title: Trump administration seeks to cut food aid for more than six million people
articles.summary: The United States Department of Agriculture published a proposed rule on Tuesday to eliminate automatic Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program eligibility tied to Temporary Assistance for Needy Families. The change would remove approximately 6.3 million people from the federal food aid programme and strip 1.8 million children of free school lunches, prompting strong criticism from Democratic lawmakers.
articles.description: Trump’s proposal builds on earlier cuts to federal food aid programme used by more than 36 million low-income Americans.

articles.headline: Republicans elect Jim Jordan as new US House minority leader
articles.title: Republicans elect Trump ally Jim Jordan as new US House minority leader
articles.summary: House Republicans chose Ohio Congressman Jim Jordan as their new minority leader in a secret ballot vote on Tuesday following their midterm election losses. Jordan, who currently chairs the House Oversight Committee and cofounded the House Freedom Caucus, defeated Steve Scalise to succeed Mike Johnson as the top Republican in the chamber.
articles.description: Ohio Congressman Jim Jordan to succeed Mike Johnson as GOP minority leader, promising unity and a robust opposition.

articles.headline: Ugandan police investigate deaths of four pupils in suspected poisoning

articles.summary: Ugandan police are investigating the deaths of four girls aged nine to 11 at Ta'aliim Primary School and Quran Memorisation Centre in Kampala on Tuesday, November 11, 2026, suspected to result from poisoning after eating oranges shared by a fellow pupil. articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh leaders pitch the State as a global investment hub

articles.headline: Pope Leo arrives in Peru for final leg of Latin American tour

articles.title: Rubio says no need for major combat operations against Iran

articles.summary: Nigerian President Bola Ahmed Tinubu launched his official re-election manifesto ahead of the general election scheduled for January 2027. articles.summary: Telangana police raided three premises in Hyderabad and rescued twenty nine women from six states who were confined for human egg harvesting. articles.summary: A Kolkata-Mumbai Air India flight was moved to an airport isolation bay on November 11, 2026, after a hijack threat note was discovered in the aircraft washroom before departure. articles.summary: Authorities apprehended a passenger and handed them over to airport police following a hoax hijack threat aboard an Air India flight from Kolkata to Mumbai. Najib previously served four years in prison for embezzling funds from the one million development berhad sovereign wealth fund and faces another pending sentence.
articles.description: Najib Razak was convicted for his role in the billion-dollar scandal involving the 1MDB sovereign wealth fund.

articles.headline: Rockstar Games releases Grand Theft Auto VI after thirteen year wait
articles.title: From Pong to GTA VI: Play your way through 50 years of video games
articles.summary: Rockstar Games releases Grand Theft Auto VI on November 19, 2026, ending a thirteen-year sequel wait within a global video game industry that generated $201.6bn in revenue in 2025, according to market research firm Newzoo. articles.description: Video games are now a $200bn business. Play through the six games that tell the story of how they got there.

articles.headline: Two Special Police Officers go missing in the Kishtwar district
articles.title: Two missing policemen found dead in J&K’s Kishtwar

Security forces, including police and the Army's Rashtriya Rifles, initiated a joint search operation across mountainous forest terrain after their mobile phones became unreachable. Officials noted that it remains premature to connect the disappearance to militant activity in the region, which has experienced previous security incidents.

articles.headline: Iran remains committed to nuclear non-proliferation treaty

articles.summary: Iran maintains its commitment to the treaty on the non-proliferation of nuclear weapons despite restricting cooperation with the international atomic energy agency following military attacks, foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei stated on Monday. While hardliners in Tehran discuss potential changes to nuclear doctrine after facility strikes, limited inspections resumed at the Bushehr nuclear power plant. Mediated talks continue between Tehran and Washington to prevent further regional escalation.

articles.headline: State security forces restrict access to proposed Siang dam site

articles.summary: Central security forces and State police have deployed barricades and concertina wires near Parong village in Arunachal Pradesh to restrict unauthorized access to the Siang river. articles.description: The Adi community has been protesting against the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project in Arunachal Pradesh, saying it threatens their land, livelihoods, and civilisation. articles.headline: Drone Federation India warns against heavy reliance on imported components
articles.title: Drone industry needs deeper localisation as import dependence poses risks: DFI
articles.summary: The Drone Federation India warned that heavy reliance on imported components leaves the domestic unmanned aerial vehicle sector vulnerable to foreign supply restrictions, particularly from China. articles.headline: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion valuation in upcoming stock market debut

articles.headline: More than 300 migrants rescued off Spain’s Canary Islands
articles.title: More than 300 migrants rescued off Spain’s Canary Islands
articles.description: More than 300 migrants were rescued off Spain’s Canary Islands amid a surge in Atlantic crossings.

Eisenkot must navigate deep divisions over military conscription and relations with Arab-led parties to succeed during his 28-day window.

articles.summary: Young chimpanzees acquire their calls through a learning process similar to human language acquisition, according to scientific insights highlighted in a newsletter on November 11. articles.headline: Indian stock markets climb in early trade amid foreign fund inflows

articles.title: Inside devastated front-line city that Russia wants Ukraine to give up

articles.headline: Myanmar military captures 11 resistance bases during southern offensive

articles.headline: Former Pakistan prime minister Imran Khan hospitalized and returned to prison

articles.headline: Telangana Health Department inspects ART facilities and issues notices to seven hospitals

articles.headline: Perovskite solar cells offer high power output requiring domestic manufacturing push in India
articles.title: Potent perovskites demand India make domestic manufacturing push
articles.summary: Perovskite solar cells represent an emerging technology in the solar industry due to their ability to extract more power from a given area compared to traditional silicon. articles.description: As China tightens export controls on this next-generation photovoltaic technology, local enterprises are racing to establish independent supply chains; government backing and national testing facilities are now vital to ensure these lightweight modules become commercially viable

articles.headline: Legislator and farmers protest against Centre regarding drought relief funds

articles.headline: Three-storey building collapses in Brooklyn
articles.title: Three-storey building collapses in Brooklyn
articles.description: A three-storey building collapsed in Brooklyn, New York, killing at least two people and injuring several others.

articles.headline: US lawmakers demand Nvidia CEO testify regarding alleged affair with Chinese intelligence
articles.title: What could Chinese intelligence have learned from Nvidia CEO’s affair?
articles.summary: Republican leaders in the United States House of Representatives have ordered Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang to attend a closed-door briefing regarding his past extramarital relationship with Alice Huang. Intelligence officials suspect the former Singapore-based tech executive acted as a Chinese intelligence operative to influence chip export restrictions. While Nvidia launched an internal investigation finding no compromised secrets, President Donald Trump confirmed Federal Bureau of Investigation scrutiny while supporting the executive.
articles.description: Nvidia says no secrets were compromised, but experts question what sensitive information may have been exposed.

articles.headline: Health experts meet to review measles elimination status across the Americas
articles.title: Why the US, Mexico and Guatemala may lose their measles-free status
articles.summary: International health experts gathered in Washington, DC, for an annual conference hosted by the Pan American Health Organization to determine whether countries including the United States, Mexico, and Guatemala retain their measles elimination status. The regional monitoring commission is reviewing epidemiological data amid a major resurgence of the virus, with the United States experiencing its largest outbreak in nearly thirty years following sustained transmission since January 2025.
articles.description: An independent commission is reviewing whether countries in the Americas still meet measles elimination criteria.

articles.headline: Cameroon power structures face continued scrutiny amid presidential absences
articles.title: Cameroon: Who is really calling the shots?
articles.summary: President Paul Biya of Cameroon returned to Yaounde on August 20 after more than 10 weeks abroad, reigniting public debate regarding executive authority and decision-making during his prolonged absences. Although the constitution permits delegation of powers and a constitutional amendment reintroduced the office of vice president, researchers and analysts note that informal networks and close presidential aides continue to heavily influence governance.
articles.description: Biya’s absences raise questions about who holds power and what comes next in Cameroon.

articles.headline: Hezbollah secretary-general welcomes US and Israeli electoral setbacks
articles.title: US election results could be positive for Lebanon, Hezbollah chief says
articles.summary: Hezbollah Secretary-General Naim Qassem has praised Republican setbacks in US midterm elections and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu failing to secure a governing majority in Israeli polls. Speaking via video-link, Qassem stated that these political shifts benefit Lebanon and reinforced his refusal to disarm the Iran-backed group while Israeli forces continue to occupy parts of southern Lebanon.
articles.description: Naim Qassem says Republican losses and Israel's election result could help Lebanon maintain sovereignty.

articles.headline: Barcelona erupts in violence after general strike
articles.title: Barcelona erupts in violence after general strike
articles.description: Protesters hurled fireworks at police and set rubbish bins ablaze in Barcelona after Spain’s general strike.

articles.headline: Amnesty International faults UN peacekeepers over South Sudan massacre
articles.title: UN peacekeepers failed to protect civilians before South Sudan massacre: Amnesty
articles.summary: United Nations peacekeepers and South Sudanese authorities failed to take adequate preventive action prior to a March 1 village raid in Abiemnom that left at least 213 people dead, according to an Amnesty International report released on November 12, 2026. The rights group stated that the mission known as UNMISS received advance warnings but did not reinforce its forces until after armed men from Mayom County carried out the attack.
articles.description: “Both the government and UNMISS had sufficient information and time to take more effective preventive action. Their failure to take stronger action cost lives,” said Tigere Chagutah, an Amnesty regional director

articles.headline: Iran designates Argentinian navy and air force as terrorist organisations
articles.title: Iran designates Argentinian navy, air force as ‘terrorist organisations’
articles.summary: The Iranian Foreign Ministry announced on Wednesday that it will classify the naval and air forces of Argentina as terrorist organisations in a reciprocal move following Argentina's similar designation of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps in March. Argentina's foreign ministry categorically rejected the measure, while historical tensions between the nations stem from the nineteen ninety-four AMIA Jewish community centre bombing in Buenos Aires.
articles.description: The move comes months after the government of Javier Milei designated Iran's IRGC as a 'terrorist organisation'.

articles.headline: US judge permits Donald Trump to proceed with defamation lawsuit against BBC
articles.title: Judge rules Trump’s $10bn BBC defamation suit can proceed
articles.summary: A federal district judge in Florida partially rejected a motion from the British Broadcasting Corporation to dismiss a defamation lawsuit filed by United States President Donald Trump. The civil case stems from an October twenty twenty-four documentary that allegedly used deceptive editing on a January sixth speech, leading the court to rule the reputation damage claims as plausibly alleged while the broadcaster maintains confidence in its legal position.
articles.description: The BBC denies defamation charge as Trump celebrates “huge victory” in court decision.

articles.headline: United Airlines bans personal AI assistants from booking passenger flights
articles.title: United won’t let your AI agent book your flight
articles.summary: United Airlines announced it will prohibit personal artificial intelligence agents from purchasing tickets on its platform, citing data privacy and regulatory compliance challenges. Company executives highlighted concerns regarding unauthorized transactions and the inability of automated tools to complete mandatory safety attestations, aligning with similar restrictions implemented by other major corporations across various industries.
articles.description: United says it won't let personal AI assistants book tickets on the airline, citing both privacy and regulatory concerns. The company says it hasn't yet seen many people try to use AI agents to book their flights, The Wall Street Journal reports, in line with observations from other businesses like Doordash. But United is concerned […]

articles.headline: Thousands march to mark Poland’s Independence Day
articles.title: Thousands march to mark Poland’s Independence Day
articles.description: Thousands of people have taken to the streets of Warsaw for Poland's annual Independence Day march

articles.headline: Hoax bomb threats target schools across Italy, UK and Ireland
articles.title: Hoax bomb threats target schools across Italy, UK and Ireland
articles.description: Thousands of schools across Italy, the UK and Ireland received hoax bomb threat emails.

articles.headline: Pinarayi Vijayan accuses Keralam government of concentrating power in chief minister office
articles.title: Keralam government centralising power in Chief Minister’s office: Pinarayi Vijayan
articles.summary: Leader of the Opposition Pinarayi Vijayan criticized the Keralam administration for centralizing authority within the Chief Minister office. Speaking at a Communist Party of India Marxist meeting in Chathurakkinar, he alleged that cabinet ministers remain uninformed about major departmental decisions. Vijayan called for a formal judicial inquiry into administrative actions regarding an electricity purchase agreement.

articles.headline: Saudi Arabia boosts crude oil production to highest level since February war
articles.title: Oil production nears pre-Iran war levels, OPEC says
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia increased crude oil output to 10.563 million barrels per day in October, reaching its highest level since military actions against Iran disrupted global energy markets in February. An OPEC report indicated that the production surge helped stabilize exports and lower fuel costs. Meanwhile, OPEC kept its global demand growth forecasts unchanged for the upcoming year.
articles.description: Saudi Arabia reports oil outputs soared to highest levels in months despite continued shipping disruptions.

articles.headline: Gaza goalkeeper killed in Israeli attack
articles.title: Gaza goalkeeper killed in Israeli attack
articles.description: Palestinian footballer Mahmoud Abdel-Malek was killed in an Israeli strike days after the Thousand Martyrs Cup.

articles.headline: White House accuses congressional Democrats of abusing power through upcoming investigations
articles.title: Trump’s White House calls Democratic plans for congressional probes ‘abuse’
articles.summary: The administration of United States President Donald Trump issued a letter criticizing incoming Democratic congressional majorities for planning investigations into executive officials. White House lawyer William Scharf argued that proposed subpoenas exceed constitutional limits and threaten government operations. Democrats countered that their oversight role is a legitimate legislative function necessary to hold officials accountable.
articles.description: Democratic lawmaker Robert Garcia denounced a White House letter as an unconstitutional attack on legislative branch.

articles.headline: Lewis Hamilton urges Israel to reopen Rafah border crossing for Gaza aid
articles.title: F1 champion Lewis Hamilton calls on Israel to open Gaza’s Rafah border
articles.summary: Formula One champion Lewis Hamilton called upon Israel to reopen the Rafah border crossing to allow critical humanitarian supplies into Gaza following heavy rains and flooding. During a visit to el-Arish, the British driver inspected Egyptian Red Crescent warehouses holding blocked aid. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu denied allegations of delaying winter supplies as the United Nations reported thousands of tents awaiting entry.
articles.description: Hamilton visited the Egypt-Gaza border as conditions worsened for Palestinians in Gaza after heavy rains.

articles.headline: First Palestinian American elected in New York talks to Al Jazeera
articles.title: First Palestinian American elected in New York talks to Al Jazeera
articles.description: Palestinian American senator-elect Aber Kawas says Gaza and affordability in New York drove her into politics.

articles.headline: Indian boxer Ambekar Meetei reaches Youth Olympics 50kg final
articles.title: Ambekar Meetei storms into men’s 50kg final at Youth Olympics
articles.summary: India's Lairenlakpam Ambekar Meetei advanced to the men's 50kg boxing final at the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games following a 5-0 semifinal win over Colombia's Izzon Jeffrey Galea Arevalo. The victory ended a 16-year wait for an Indian boxer in a Youth Olympics final, matching Shiva Thapa's milestone from the Singapore 2010 Games. Ambekar trains at the National Institute of Sports in Patiala.
articles.description: Ambekar’s semifinal victory against the Colombian ended a 16-year wait for an Indian boxer in a Youth Olympics final, matching the milestone set by Shiva Thapa at the inaugural Singapore 2010 Games

articles.headline: Sunil Chhetri joins FIFA Player Impact Programme as first male participant
articles.title: Sunil Chhetri joins FIFA Player Impact Programme as first male participant
articles.summary: Former India men's national team captain Sunil Chhetri joined the FIFA Player Impact Programme as its first male participant, according to an All India Football Federation media release. The initiative expands on its 2025 female-only pilot to include 13 global footballers. Participants gathered in Boston, Massachusetts, United States, for a workshop aimed at driving social change through sport.
articles.description: Chhetri joins the international line-up featuring FIFA Women’s World Cup winner Alexia Putellas of Spain, Canada’s Jessie Fleming, England’s Michelle Agyemang, Nigeria’s Rasheedat Ajibade and Brazil’s Gabi Nunes, among others

articles.headline: Karnataka minister directs blacklisting of Larsen and Toubro over project delays
articles.title: Karnataka Minister Eshwar Khandre asks officials to blacklist Larsen & Toubro for ‘delaying’ works
articles.summary: Karnataka Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Minister Eshwar Khandre directed officials to blacklist Larsen and Toubro Limited for slow progress on drinking water projects. The firm was executing facilities for 388 rural habitations in Dharwad district, Kalghatgi town, and Saundatti taluk in Belagavi district. Officials reported inadequate workers and slow pipeline progress during a meeting held amid state drought conditions.
articles.description: Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Minister Eshwar Khandre has directed that Larsen & Toubro Limited be blacklisted for alleged slow progress of work in drinking water projects

articles.headline: Centuries from Dhananjaya and Kusal boost Sri Lanka against Pakistan
articles.title: Centurions Dhananjaya and Kusal flay inexperienced Pakistan attack to boost Sri Lanka in first Test
articles.summary: Dhananjaya de Silva and Kusal Mendis struck unbeaten centuries to guide Sri Lanka to 404-4 at stumps on day three of the first Test against Pakistan. De Silva reached 167 not out while captain Mendis scored 117 not out, forming an unbroken 249-run partnership. The performance pushed Sri Lanka close to Pakistan's first-innings total of 434-9 declared on Wednesday.
articles.description: De Silva struck an unbeaten 167 with 20 fours to raise his 14th test hundred, while Mendis celebrated his elevation to the test captaincy with 117 not out

articles.headline: US midterms leave several congressional races and governorships undecided
articles.title: Which key races remain undecided one week after the US midterms?
articles.summary: More than a week after the United States midterm elections, numerous congressional races and two governorships remain uncalled as vote counting continues in states including Mississippi, Alaska, North Carolina, and Kansas. While Democrats secured majorities in the House of Representatives and the Senate, close margins and mail-in ballots have delayed final outcomes, with various certification deadlines stretching into December according to election officials.
articles.description: Democrats hope several races that are still too close to call will further expand their majorities in the US Congress.

articles.headline: Linda Noskova defeats Coco Gauff to reach WTA Finals semifinals
articles.title: Linda Noskova bests Gauff to reach WTA Finals semis, Americans battle for second spot
articles.summary: Linda Noskova advanced to the semifinal round of the WTA Finals by defeating Coco Gauff in straight sets on Tuesday. The reigning Wimbledon champion secured her spot after one hour and fifteen minutes of play. Meanwhile, Jessica Pegula kept her own tournament hopes alive by eliminating Marta Kostyuk, leaving the final Group 1 placement to be decided by upcoming matches.
articles.description: Noskova, the reigning Wimbledon champion, posted a straight-sets victory to guarantee her advancement out of round-robin play

articles.headline: Manchester United reportedly reach verbal agreement with Mauricio Pochettino
articles.title: Manchester United reach ‘verbal agreement’ with Pochettino to replace Carrick
articles.summary: Manchester United reached a verbal agreement with United States coach Mauricio Pochettino to replace Michael Carrick as manager amid a dismal start to the Premier League season. Carrick faces dismissal following a club record slump that left the team in the relegation zone. U.S. Soccer would be owed compensation for the manager, who recently signed an extension through the 2030 World Cup.
articles.description: U.S. Soccer would be due compensation should Pochettino move to Manchester, with the 54-year-old understood to have a $10 million (£7.5 million) release clause

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister urges Singapore to focus on model township
articles.title: CM Naidu urges Singapore to focus on integrated model township in Andhra Pradesh
articles.summary: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu met with a Singapore delegation led by Minister Gan Siow Huang in Amaravati to discuss bilateral strategic initiatives. Naidu requested a focus on developing an integrated model township and highlighted targets to complete capital infrastructure by March 2027 alongside massive renewable energy plans. The visiting officials praised the state government's collaborative progress and discussed future civil services training programs.
articles.description: Naidu calls for a coordinated approach to implementing the projects identified in the MoU between Andhra Pradesh and Singapore

articles.headline: Rahmat Shah becomes first Afghan to enter top ten Test rankings
articles.title: Rahmat Shah becomes first Afghan to break into top 10 of ICC Men's Test Player Rankings
articles.summary: Afghanistan cricket captain Rahmat Shah advanced to seventh place in the International Cricket Council Test batter rankings, becoming the first player from his nation to reach the top ten. The milestone followed his score of 173 runs against Zimbabwe in Sharjah. Additional updates included career-best ratings for West Indies spinner Jomel Warrican and upward movements for various Indian bowlers during ongoing limited-overs fixtures.
articles.description: Rahmat climbed six places to reach seventh in the latest rankings for Test batters after scoring 173 in the first match of Afghanistan’s two-Test series against Zimbabwe

articles.headline: IMD predicts depression over Bay of Bengal by November 15
articles.title: Depression over Bay of Bengal likely by November 15: IMD
articles.summary: According to the India Meteorological Department, a low-pressure area forming over the south-east Bay of Bengal on November 13 is expected to intensify into a depression by November 15. The weather system follows an upper air cyclonic circulation over the South Andaman Sea. Officials stated that no rainfall alerts have been issued yet for the State, and cyclone formation remains unlikely.

articles.headline: Sheikh Hasina plans return to Bangladesh despite facing death sentence
articles.title: Will Sheikh Hasina return to Bangladesh?
articles.summary: Former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina announced plans to return to Bangladesh in December despite facing a death sentence and hanging. Hasina was forced to resign and flee following street protests more than two years ago, subsequently residing in India. The Dhaka government previously turned down her request for a new passport to facilitate her controversial homecoming.
articles.description: The former Bangladeshi PM says she is planning to go back, despite a death sentence.

articles.headline: Hundreds of Italian schools receive bomb threats in suspected cyber-attack
articles.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
articles.summary: Approximately 300 schools across Italy received bomb threats on Wednesday, prompting precautionary evacuations before authorities lifted the alarms. Education Minister Giuseppe Valditara stated that the emails were likely part of a broader cyber-attack strategy intended to cause alarm across Europe, mirroring recent hoaxes targeting airports. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni convened top ministers and intelligence chiefs, noting no evidence of concrete danger.
articles.description: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public.

articles.headline: Zohran Mamdani gains influence as Democrats analyze midterm election results
articles.title: Zohran Mamdani’s influence grows as Democrats eye 2028 strategies
articles.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani emerged as a prominent figure following the midterm elections after Democratic Socialists of America-backed candidates achieved notable victories nationwide. Progressive operatives credit Mamdani with establishing a populist model centered on affordability, following his successful mayoral campaign against Andrew Cuomo. Supporters believe this strategy will remain vital as the Democratic Party prepares for the 2028 elections.
articles.description: Progressive strategists explain how Mamdani's 2025 mayoral campaign offered a 'real model' for other progressives.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu government sanctions infrastructure works worth ₹376 crore
articles.title: Govt. clears infrastructure works for ₹376 crore across State; roads set for upgrade
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu government sanctioned 2,880 infrastructure projects worth ₹376.65 crore across urban local bodies on October 28. Implemented under the Chief Minister’s Integrated Urban Development Mission, the initiative funds road upgrades, water supply schemes, and waterbody restorations across Chennai and other municipalities to prepare for ongoing monsoon rains through December.
articles.description: The govt. clears 2,880 works to improve water supply, waterbodies, parks, and retaining walls in Chennai Corporation areas, other municipal corporations, municipalities, and town panchayats

articles.headline: Missing infant rescued after being buried alive in South Carolina
articles.title: Missing 11-month-old baby rescued after being buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
articles.summary: Police in Lexington County rescued an 11-month-old baby who was buried alive inside a crate by his father, Michael Comer, following a domestic dispute. Rescuers discovered the child on Tuesday near the suspect's residence after noticing disturbed soil. The infant is currently receiving hospital care and is expected to make a full recovery from the ordeal.
articles.description: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.

articles.headline: Historical examination revisits controversial underarm delivery by Trevor Chappell
articles.title: Sandpapergate and rubbing the wrong way
articles.summary: Australian cricket history reflects recurring debates surrounding sportsmanship, highlighted by Trevor Chappell delivering an underarm ball against New Zealand in 1981 at captain Greg Chappell's insistence. The controversial play, though legal at the time, prompted widespread outrage and led authorities to rewrite the Laws of the Game to explicitly ban underarm bowling. Greg Chappell later cited fixture exhaustion and tournament pressure as the primary reasons behind the tactical decision that impacted international cricket relations.
articles.description: Khawaja has set the cat amongst the pigeons and the repercussions, if any, of his expose in the scandal will manifest themselves in the next few weeks and months, when Australia are confronted with a packed schedule

articles.headline: Portugal cancels flights and shuts schools nationwide ahead of Storm Charles
articles.title: Portugal cancels more than 300 flights, shuts schools due to Storm Charles
articles.summary: Portugal cancelled more than 300 flights and shut down all schools nationwide as Storm Charles approached the mainland on Wednesday. The national weather agency recorded wind gusts exceeding 120 kilometres per hour, while government directives kept streets largely deserted. Prime Minister Luis Montenegro chaired a crisis unit to monitor emergency measures. Although the severe weather caused localized street flooding, it passed without inflicting widespread structural damage before heading toward Spain.
articles.description: Authorities spared no effort in preparation for the Atlantic storm after criticism following January's Storm Kristin.

articles.headline: Democrats prepare to use congressional committees to investigate Jeffrey Epstein files
articles.title: Can Democrats shed some new light on the Epstein files when they take over?
articles.summary: Incoming Democratic lawmakers holding majority control in both the United States House of Representatives and Senate plan to utilize congressional oversight powers starting in January to demand answers from the Donald Trump administration regarding the investigation into convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, according to lawmakers who intend to issue subpoenas and hold hearings.
articles.description: Lawmakers have pledged to use new majorities in House and Senate to pursue the investigation into Epstein's network.

articles.headline: Akhilesh Yadav defends upcoming Ayodhya visit and criticises demonetisation
articles.title: God belongs to everyone, says Akhilesh on his Ayodhya visit
articles.summary: Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav defended his planned December 12 family visit to the Ram Temple in Ayodhya during a press conference in Lucknow, stating that God belongs to everyone. He criticised the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party over governance issues and marked a decade of demonetisation as an ocean of corruption.
articles.description: Claiming the BJP wins elections through dishonesty and fraud, the SP chief said that voters have made up their mind to bring his party to power in U.P.; he called for a voter list to be linked to Aadhaar

articles.headline: Nationalist demonstrators gather in Warsaw for annual Independence Day march
articles.title: Tens of thousands join Poland’s nationalist Independence Day march
articles.summary: Tens of thousands of nationalist sympathisers assembled in central Warsaw on November 11 for Poland's annual Independence Day march amid heightened political tensions following a mass shooting in Krakow that killed six people and wounded more than a dozen individuals, prompting appeals for restraint from Prime Minister Donald Tusk.
articles.description: Polish PM Donald Tusk calls for restraint, urging unity after deadly Krakow attack linked to far-right ideology.

articles.headline: Ladakh electoral officer prohibits protests in Leh and Kargil during elections
articles.title: Amid call for Ladakh protest, CEO prohibits dharnas in Leh, Kargil over upcoming polls
articles.summary: The Chief Electoral Officer of Ladakh issued an order prohibiting all protests, dharnas, and rallies within the municipal limits of Leh and Kargil while the Model Code of Conduct remains in force for local body elections scheduled between November 21 and December 4, countering civil society groups threatening agitations over unfulfilled demands.
articles.description: The order came a day after Ladakh’s civil society groups announced that agitations to push a slew of demands would resume on November 12

articles.headline: Germany phases out Chinese-made drones over military security concerns
articles.title: German military to stop using Chinese-made drones, citing security concerns
articles.summary: Germany's military is discontinuing the use of Chinese-manufactured drones to enhance self-sufficiency and technological sovereignty, according to a defence ministry spokesperson on November 11, 2026. The equipment will be replaced by European products following individual risk assessments. China's foreign ministry criticized the decision as discriminatory, while manufacturer DJI stated its products do not pose security risks.
articles.description: Drones from Chinese manufacturers had previously been permitted as a cost-effective option for target practice and training purposes; they will now be replaced with European products

articles.headline: Union Cabinet extends micro credit guarantee scheme until March 2031
articles.title: Government extends micro credit guarantee scheme for five years
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the five-year continuation of the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units on November 11, 2026, aiming to facilitate ₹12.6 lakh crore in loans under the Pradhan Mentri Mudra Yojana. Information and Broadcasting Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated the corpus of ₹5,000 crore mitigates default risks for lending institutions through the National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Limited.
articles.description: Collateral-free loans have created a whole new generation of entrepreneurs who previously could not avail loans from the formal banking system

articles.headline: Italy evacuates hundreds of schools following anonymous bomb threats
articles.title: Italy evacuates over 300 schools due to bomb alert, with threats in Scotland and Ireland
articles.summary: Italian authorities evacuated 312 schools on November 11, 2026, after receiving anonymous emailed bomb threats. Similar messages were reported in Ireland, Scotland, and Northern Ireland, though no evacuations occurred there. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni stated there is no concrete danger, describing the incidents as hoaxes intended to cause alarm following recent disruptions across European institutions.
articles.description: Italian Premier Giorgia Meloni said there was no indication of any “concrete danger” to schools and that the threats appeared aimed at “generating alarm and concern”

articles.headline: Farmers' group urges end to penalties for stubble burning in India
articles.title: Stop penalising farmers for stubble burning, says RSS body
articles.summary: The Bharatiya Kisan Sangh, a farmers' organisation, has called on Indian authorities to stop penalising farmers for stubble burning. Following Supreme Court observations on air pollution, the group demanded the withdrawal of fines and FIRs. They proposed a government procurement system for crop residue to provide farmers with income and discourage the practice of burning.
articles.description: Bharatiya Kisan Sangh hails Supreme Court’s observations, seeks withdrawal of fines and FIRs against farmers

articles.headline: Bengaluru hospitals report surge in firecracker injuries during Deepavali
articles.title: Festival of lights turns grim for many as firecracker injuries surge across Bengaluru hospitals
articles.summary: Bengaluru hospitals treated over two hundred firecracker-related injuries during Deepavali, leaving children, elderly individuals, and bystanders facing vision risks and burns. Victoria Hospital admitted seven patients with severe burns, including two critical cases in the intensive care unit, while multiple eye care facilities such as Minto Ophthalmic Hospital and Narayana Nethralaya recorded numerous corneal tears and vision impairments.
articles.description: Two burn victims, including a seven-month-old pregnant woman and an eight-year-old boy, are critical; they are being treated in the ICU of the Mahabodhi Burns Centre at Victoria Hospital

articles.headline: Union Cabinet approves Noida Metro Aqua Line extension
articles.title: Cabinet approves extension of metro line from Noida Sector 51 to Greater Noida Sector 4
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet approved an 8.45-km extension of the Noida Metro Aqua Line from Sector 51 to Greater Noida Sector 4 on November 11, 2026. The project includes five elevated stations and aims to improve connectivity to commercial hubs, IT offices, and residential societies. This expansion will bring the total metro network to 71.88 km.
articles.description: Once the corridor is open, Noida and Greater Noida city will have 71.88 km of active metro rail network; the phase aims to integrate key zones of Noida, including commercial hubs

articles.headline: Court extends police custody for five accused in Tiger Shroff attack
articles.title: Gun attack on Tiger Shroff: Police custody of five accused extended till November 16
articles.summary: A special MCOCA court extended the police custody of five suspects, including Phool Singh, until November 16 in the Tiger Shroff firing case. Prosecutors requested the extension to confront the accused with co-suspect Suneha Pandit, who is allegedly linked to cryptocurrency-based financing. Authorities are also verifying claims that Phool Singh is a minor.
articles.description: A team has been sent to Haryana to verify Phool Singh’s claim that he is a minor; police said the age-verification report would be submitted on November 18

articles.headline: Three CRPF personnel injured in militant shooting in south Kashmir's Kulgam
articles.title: Three CRPF jawans injured in terror attack in Kashmir’s Kulgam
articles.summary: Three Central Reserve Police Foundation personnel sustained bullet injuries on November 11, 2026, when motorcycle-borne terrorists opened fire at a checkpoint in south Kashmir’s Kulgam district. The wounded officers were transferred to a hospital in Anantnag. According to Central Reserve Police Foundation Director General G.P Singh, security forces launched a search operation to apprehend the perpetrators as Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha was visiting the area.
articles.description: Terrorists fired at the CRPF checkpoint on a day when the J&K L-G was scheduled to attend an event in the district; one critically injured man was flown to Srinagar

articles.headline: Kedarnath temple portals close for winter season
articles.title: Kedarnath temple closes for winter
articles.summary: The Kedarnath temple portals were ceremoniously closed for the winter on November 11, 2026, following a pilgrimage season that saw over 19 lakh devotees. The deity was moved to the Omkareshwar Temple in Ukhimath for the next six months. Across the Char Dham shrines, record footfall exceeded 60 lakh visitors, significantly boosting the Uttarakhand economy.
articles.description: More than 19 lakh pilgrims visited shrine during season; Char Sham footfall crosses 60 lakh

articles.headline: Tata Power reports 32 percent profit growth in second quarter
articles.title: Tata Power Q2 profit jumps 32% to ₹1,652 crore
articles.summary: Tata Power recorded a 32 percent year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to ₹1,652 crore for the quarter ending September. Revenue rose to ₹19,635 crore, driven by thermal and hydro segment growth. Separately, the company is challenging a Singapore court order that attached shares in two subsidiaries to enforce a $490.32 million arbitration award.
articles.description: Thermal and hydro operations led growth, with earnings surging 158.3% to ₹1,066.66 crore in Q2.

articles.headline: Former Vice-President Jagdeep Dhankhar admitted to AIIMS
articles.title: Former V-P Dhankhar collapses during morning walk, admitted to AIIMS
articles.summary: Former Vice-President Jagdeep Dhankhar was admitted to the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) in New Delhi on November 11, 2026, after collapsing during a morning walk. The 75-year-old is receiving care at the cardio-neuro centre. Dhankhar, who previously underwent angioplasty in 2025, has experienced multiple fainting episodes over the past two years.
articles.description: The 75-year-old former Rajya Sabha chairman has been admitted to the hospital’s cardio-neuro centre and is currently under the care of the department of cardiology for medical evaluation and treatment, the sources said

articles.headline: Spain faces first general strike in 14 years over housing crisis
articles.title: ‘It’s just too expensive’: Housing and wages at the heart of Spain’s strike
articles.summary: Demonstrators in Madrid have closed major roads during a nationwide general strike sparked by a severe lack of affordable housing and inadequate wages. The widespread protests follow the eviction of an elderly resident over surging rents. According to the Bank of Spain, the country needs hundreds of thousands of new homes, while Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez faces a snap general election.
articles.description: Mass walkout across several cities marks first general strike in 14 years.

articles.headline: Israeli military operations devastate wheat production in southern Lebanon
articles.title: Israel is ‘disrupting entire ecosystems’, including Lebanon’s wheat crop
articles.summary: Military actions in southern Lebanon and the Bekaa Valley have severely damaged agricultural production and displaced local farmers, according to researchers and food security experts. Data from Lebanon's National Council for Scientific Research shows dramatic losses in wheat-growing areas. Specialists warn that ongoing conflict and rising living costs are destroying small farming livelihoods across the region permanently.
articles.description: Lebanese wheat production hit by war as farmlands face severe destruction in the south and Bekaa Valley.

articles.headline: India advances to SAFF Championship semifinals with Maldives win
articles.title: SAFF Championship: Suhail Bhat penalty takes India into semifinals as toppers
articles.summary: India advanced to the SAFF Championship semifinals as Group B winners after securing a 1-0 victory against Maldives at the National Stadium on November 11, 2026. Suhail Ahmad Bhat scored the decisive penalty in the 38th minute, while goalkeeper Priyansh Dubey delivered crucial late saves during stoppage time to preserve the clean sheet for the defending champions.
articles.description: The defending champions finished the group stage with six points, ahead of Pakistan on three, while Maldives bowed out without a point

articles.headline: Denmark Supreme Court prepares to rule on contested housing legislation
articles.title: Inside the fight against Denmark’s ‘straight up racist’ housing law
articles.summary: Denmark's Supreme Court is set to deliver a crucial ruling on housing legislation that allows for the sale or demolition of nonprofit homes in areas with high proportions of residents classified as non-Western. Seven families are challenging their former landlord in a case supported by a previous European Union ruling that raised questions about ethnic discrimination within the controversial law.
articles.description: Residents say Denmark’s ‘ghetto law’ is breaking up strong communities, as the Supreme Court prepares to rule.

articles.headline: Qualcomm faces potential job cuts in India amid global workforce reduction
articles.title: Qualcomm India layoffs: Over 1,000 jobs at risk amid global cuts
articles.summary: U.S. chipmaker Qualcomm is implementing a global workforce reduction, with analysts estimating over 1,000 positions may be affected in India. CEO Cristiano Amon described the move as a performance-focused initiative. While the company has not confirmed specific local figures, reports indicate employee separations have begun in Bengaluru and Hyderabad following a decline in fiscal 2026 revenue.
articles.description: CEO Cristiano Amon has described the exercise as a performance-focused reduction, while Qualcomm’s latest annual report puts its global workforce at 57,000; the company did not respond to a request for comment on the reported India cuts

articles.headline: Supreme Court panel suggests three-year sand mining phase-out roadmap
articles.title: Central committee suggests three-year roadmap to phase out unsustainable sand mining from active river channels
articles.summary: The Supreme Court-appointed Central Empowered Committee submitted a report on November 2, 2026, recommending a time-bound roadmap to phase out unsustainable sand extraction from active river channels over three years. The statutory body suggested developing alternative sources such as recycled construction waste and scientific reservoir desiltation to protect river systems.
articles.description: In its report, the CEC observes that while sand and gravel are crucial ingredients for infrastructure and construction, their unscientific or excessive extraction from active channels and floodplains disrupts the delicate dynamic balance of river systems

articles.headline: Kerala government rolls out drought preparedness measures ahead of summer
articles.title: Keralam government rolls out drought preparedness measures ahead of summer
articles.summary: The Kerala government has placed authorities on high alert to tackle potential El Niño-induced summer droughts and drinking water shortages. Water Resources Minister Mons Joseph announced that statutory committees chaired by members of the legislative assembly will operate starting January to coordinate mitigation efforts and complete Jal Jeevan Mission projects.
articles.description: Statutory committees chaired by MLAs will be constituted in every Assembly constituency to coordinate drought mitigation efforts and address water supply issues within a fixed time frame

articles.headline: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar seeks official recognition for Kannada flag
articles.title: State to pursue official recognition for Kannada flag, language: CM
articles.summary: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar announced on November 11, 2026, that the state government is committed to securing official recognition for the Kannada language and flag. Speaking at a book release event, he stated that the administration would discuss the matter during the upcoming legislature session to enact necessary legislation.

articles.headline: Bengaluru police use artificial intelligence to assess emergency response system
articles.title: Bengaluru police use AI to assess 112 emergency response
articles.summary: The Bengaluru City Police gathered feedback from over 1.5 lakh citizens within three months using an artificial intelligence-powered voice platform developed with startup VocalLabs AI. City Police Commissioner Seemant Kumar Singh stated that the automated system evaluates the 112 Emergency Response Support System performance across multiple Indian languages.

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh government prepares to introduce X+II education system
articles.title: Govt. intensifies efforts to introduce X+II education system from next academic year
articles.summary: The Andhra Pradesh government is preparing to implement the X+II education system starting from the next academic year on November 11, 2026, according to Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy. The reform aims to restructure schooling into primary, secondary, and senior secondary levels to enhance student learning. Authorities intend to address a 40 percent dropout rate among specific communities while protecting teaching staff benefits.
articles.description: CM expresses concern over dropout rate after Class 10 and hoped that start of Class 12 can check this

articles.headline: Ecologists warn Hebbal tunnel project threatens local bird habitats
articles.title: Hebbal Short tunnel project threatens green corridor supporting 199 bird species: Study
articles.summary: A rapid environmental impact assessment released on November 11, 2026, reveals that 199 bird species inhabit the area surrounding the proposed Hebbal Short Tunnel alignment in Bengaluru. Researchers from Azim Premji University cautioned that the underground twin-tube project and the removal of 1,128 marked trees would fragment wildlife corridors, increase pollution, and worsen urban heat island effects.

articles.headline: Brazil electoral court fines Meta for non-compliance during election
articles.title: Brazil electoral court fines Meta, sees no deliberate election bias
articles.summary: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) of Brazil fined Meta 7.5 million reais on November 10, 2026, for failing to fully comply with judicial orders during the recent presidential runoff. While the court noted technical failures, it found no evidence of deliberate bias. The penalty follows complaints regarding content moderation and platform tool usage during the campaign.
articles.description: Meta told the Court last month it had adopted ​measures to ensure equal treatment of ‌the two campaigns

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh seeks broader cooperation with Singapore beyond capital development
articles.title: Andhra Pradesh seeks wider partnership with Singapore beyond Amaravati
articles.summary: Andhra Pradesh Minister Nara Lokesh proposed expanding regional partnership with Singapore to encompass education, digital governance, and leadership training during a meeting of the Joint Implementation Standing Committee in Amaravati on November 11, 2026. The discussions evaluated progress on developing Amaravati and focused on capacity-building initiatives for teachers, government officials, and administrative systems.
articles.description: Lokesh proposes training programmes for teachers, Ministers and officials; seeks cooperation in digital governance at third JISC meeting

articles.headline: Air India narrows financial losses during the first half
articles.title: Air India’s losses narrow in H1 by ₹2,000 crore
articles.summary: Singapore Airlines reported that its share of losses from Air India decreased to S$361.7 million during the first half of the 2026-27 financial year, indicating that the Tata Group-owned carrier reduced its overall losses compared to the previous year. Chief Executive Officer Tewolde Gebremariam has prioritized cost rationalisation, operational efficiencies, and stricter expense scrutiny to support the airline's ongoing turnaround.
articles.description: Air India is under pressure to cut costs after a consolidated net loss of ₹22,238 crore in FY2025-26

articles.headline: India bans export of unsorted lithium-ion battery waste and scrap
articles.title: Government bars export of lithium-ion battery waste and scrap containing black mass
articles.summary: The Indian government banned the export of unsorted waste and scrap from primary cells, batteries, and electric accumulators lacking lead, cadmium, or mercury with immediate effect. The Directorate General of Foreign Trade announced that the export policy for this material, known as lithium-ion battery black mass, shifted from free to prohibited. The decision aims to retain valuable materials like lithium, cobalt, nickel, manganese, and graphite for domestic recycling and manufacturing use.
articles.description: Black mass, the particulate powdered mixture recovered during the recycling of lithium-ion batteries, is particularly essential for India's electronics and electric vehicle as well as renewable energy storage ecosystem

articles.headline: Cairo court adjourns retrial of journalist Lina Attalah amid UN criticism
articles.title: Egyptian journalist's retrial adjourned as UN warns of 'assaults on press freedom'
articles.summary: A criminal court in Cairo adjourned the retrial of Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Attalah until 18 November after defence lawyers requested a new judge. The legal proceedings follow a recent conviction for operating a website without a licence and a separate in absentia sentence. The United Nations has criticized the case, warning of widening assaults on press freedom by Egyptian authorities against independent newsrooms.
articles.description: Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Attalah is being tried on the charge of "publishing false news" and potentially faces imprisonment.

articles.headline: Four grizzly bears euthanized following fatal attack in British Columbia
articles.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
articles.summary: The British Columbia Conservation Officer Service confirmed that a sow and three cubs were responsible for the fatal attack on Jennifer Balcarras and her daughter Selah Reed earlier this month. Authorities euthanized the four bears to ensure public safety. DNA analysis linked the animals to the incident, which officials described as a rare predatory attack.
articles.description: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.

articles.headline: Schools across Italy evacuated following mass hoax bomb threats
articles.title: Schools across Italy evacuated after receiving email bomb alerts
articles.summary: Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools on Wednesday after receiving approximately 6,300 identical hoax bomb threats via email. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni stated there is no concrete danger, and officials suspect a coordinated cyberattack. Similar alerts were reported in Scotland and Northern Ireland, where police also dismissed the messages as non-credible hoaxes amid rising European security concerns.
articles.description: Italian PM Meloni says there is no danger as UK and Northern Ireland authorities also report 'bogus' alerts.

articles.headline: Kenya discharges final Ebola patient and starts countdown to virus-free status
articles.title: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status
articles.summary: Kenya has discharged its seventh and final Ebola patient, marking a key milestone in its response to an outbreak that began in October following an importation from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Health Minister Aden Duale announced that all tracked contacts have completed monitoring, leaving the nation to begin a 42-day countdown toward an official virus-free declaration under World Health Organization guidelines.
articles.description: The country begins a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded.

articles.headline: Tiruchi police arrest six individuals for murder of two teenagers
articles.title: Six arrested for murder of two minor boys at Samayapuram near Tiruchi
articles.summary: Special teams of the Tiruchi district police arrested six young adults on November 10, 2026, for the murder of 17-year-old boys S. Veera Rahul and R. Vishal in Samayapuram. According to authorities, a personal dispute following a hospital visit led to the fatal assault, and one suspect sustained a police gunshot wound during a weapon recovery attempt.
articles.description: One of the accused was shot in the left knee by a police officer using his service weapon after he allegedly attempted to assault police personnel while being taken for weapon recovery

articles.headline: Perumal Murugan exposed book procurement irregularities at Coimbatore library
articles.title: The controversy surrounding procurement of books for Periyar Arivulagam in Coimbatore | Explained
articles.summary: Sahitya Akademi winner Perumal Murugan highlighted widespread irregularities regarding book acquisitions for the Periyar Arivulagam library in Coimbatore on November 6, 2026. The author alleged that thousands of potentially artificial intelligence-generated volumes containing factual errors were acquired at severely inflated prices. This discovery triggered a Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption inquiry, potential court intervention, and fierce political disputes between rival parties in Tamil Nadu.
articles.description: The controversy caused a furore in Tamil Nadu, as the case heads into a Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption inquiry, court intervention and the scope of investigations has now expanded to include inventories in several other libraries.

articles.headline: African rights body appeals to Niger president over Mahamid Arab community
articles.title: African rights body raises alarm over treatment of Niger’s Mahamid Arabs
articles.summary: The African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights has submitted an urgent appeal to Niger President Abdourahamane Tchiani regarding alleged rights violations against the Mahamid Arab community in the Diffa region. Sent on November 6, the appeal addresses reported restrictions on access to water, education, healthcare, and identity documents, alongside unverified claims of an impending expulsion order set by local authorities.
articles.description: Rights commission appeals to Niger president over alleged abuses against Mahamid.

articles.headline: British police arrest US soldier near Gloucester for suspected Russian espionage
articles.title: US soldier arrested for Russia spying: What we know
articles.summary: British counterterrorism police arrested a forty-one-year-old United States military member near Gloucester on suspicion of assisting foreign intelligence and disclosing protected information. Authorities stated the suspect was based at Imjin Barracks in Innsworth. The investigation involves close collaboration between British and American law enforcement agencies, as confirmed by London Metropolitan Police and the Federal Bureau of Investigation.
articles.description: A 41-year-old man has been arrested near Gloucester on suspicion of offences under the National Security Act.

articles.headline: Israeli rights group condemns authorities over jailed doctor's deteriorating health
articles.title: Rights group raises concerns about jailed Dr Abu Safia amid strikes on Gaza
articles.summary: Physicians for Human Rights Israel stated that jailed hospital director Dr Hussam Abu Safia lost fourteen kilograms and faced uninvestigated chest pain. Israeli courts rejected petitions to release fourteen detained doctors and allow independent medical examinations. Abu Safia was captured during a December two thousand twenty-four raid on Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza, where the health sector faces severe infrastructure destruction.
articles.description: PHRI says the arbitrary detention of Gaza doctors violates individual rights and undermines healthcare system.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu considers approaching Supreme Court over river authority powers
articles.title: Tamil Nadu may approach Supreme Court seeking greater powers for Cauvery Water Management Authority
articles.summary: Tamil Nadu is considering approaching the Supreme Court to grant enforcement powers to the Cauvery Water Management Authority, modelled after the Bhakra Beas Management Board. The State expressed frustration that upper riparian Karnataka repeatedly failed to comply with mandated water release orders, despite significant reservoir shortfalls recorded across the inter-State border.
articles.description: The State wants the Authority to be modelled along the lines of the Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB)

articles.headline: Passenger train derails in India, leaving several injured
articles.title: Passenger train derails in India, leaving several injured
articles.description: Video from inside the driver’s cabin captured the moment a train derailed in India’s Assam state.

articles.headline: Madras High Court orders corruption inquiry into alleged artificial intelligence books
articles.title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'
articles.summary: The Madras High Court directed the anti-corruption agency to investigate public library purchases in Tamil Nadu involving books suspected of containing false information generated by artificial intelligence. Novelist Perumal Murugan raised concerns regarding nearly eighteen hundred titles supplied by Agal Vilakku Pathippagam to the Periyar Arivulagam library in Coimbatore city, prompting state officials to conduct internal audits and freeze publisher bank accounts.
articles.description: The Tamil Nadu government has ordered an internal audit of library collections across the state.

articles.headline: Indian stock markets close higher for second consecutive session
articles.title: Stock markets end higher; Sensex and Nifty jump nearly 1%
articles.summary: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty indices rose nearly 1% on November 11, 2026, extending a winning streak. Gains were driven by foreign institutional investor inflows, positive second-quarter corporate results, and lower crude oil prices. Mahindra & Mahindra and InterGlobe Aviation led the rally, while the broader market sentiment remained bolstered by a resilient Indian rupee.
articles.description: The 30-share BSE Sensex rallied 772.75 points, or 0.95%, to settle at 81,879.40, and the 50-share NSE Nifty closed 210.40 points, or 0.84%, higher at 25,255.05.

articles.headline: Israel kills Gaza goalkeeper days after playing in cup for slain athletes
articles.title: Israel kills Gaza goalkeeper days after playing in cup for slain athletes
articles.description: Mahmoud Abdel-Malek, a 20-year-old goalkeeper for Gaza Sports Club, was killed in an Israeli airstrike on Gaza City.

articles.headline: Bengaluru police recover stolen international sports medals and arrest two suspects
articles.title: Bengaluru police recover M.M. Somaya’s 1980 Olympic gold medal, seven other international medals; two arrested
articles.summary: Law enforcement authorities in Bengaluru apprehended two individuals and retrieved eight prestigious international sports medals that were stolen from the home of former hockey player M.M. Somaya. The stolen items included a gold medal from the 1980 Moscow Olympics. According to the police, the burglary occurred while the family was visiting the Kodagu district between October 25 and 28, 2026. Investigators tracked down the suspects on November 9, 2026, and recovered the valuables from a Rajajinagar establishment and an accused person's residence in Hoskote.
articles.description: Police also recovered a traditional dagger of the Kodava community, a camera and an Olympic kit bag, along with the two-wheeler allegedly used to commit the offence.

articles.headline: US House blocks impeachment articles against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth
articles.title: Did Democrats save Pete Hegseth from impeachment?
articles.summary: The United States House of Representatives voted 211-204 on November 11, 2026, to refer impeachment articles against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to the House Judiciary Committee. Introduced by Republican Congressman Thomas Massie and backed by Democrats, the motion effectively halted the push for the remainder of the current Congress. Eleven absent Democratic lawmakers prevented opposition numbers from defeating the procedural move.
articles.description: Eleven Democrats are absent from procedural vote that narrowly shelves House impeachment vote against defence secretary.

articles.headline: UK defends Falklands Sea Lion oil project against Argentinian legal challenge
articles.title: What’s the Falklands oil project at the heart of latest UK-Argentina spat?
articles.summary: Attorney General Ellie Reeves stated that billions of pounds for the Falkland Islands would be lost if Argentina succeeds in blocking the Sea Lion oil project. Argentina initiated arbitration proceedings and brought a legal challenge before the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea, citing environmental concerns and sovereignty claims over the territory administered by the United Kingdom since 1833.
articles.description: UK says it will defend its interests at tribunal hearing, as Argentina seeks measures to block the offshore project.
